name: chart
description: A chart under the answer, only when the user asks for a chart, graph or diagram. A log (a weight, a measurement): give its path as source and no points; the app reads and plots every entry itself, so do not cat it first and do not copy its values. Otherwise points, at most 60: numbers you counted from the results, or ones you worked out yourself, such as counts in a text the user gave.

kind.description: line for a value over time, bar to compare, pie for parts of one whole.

title.description: A short title, in the language of the reply.

unit.description: What the values are in: "kg", "bilder". A log's own unit is used when left out.

source.description: The path of a log to plot, every entry by its date.

points.description: The values, in order, when there is no source.
